When I make chocolate covered anything, I’ll fill the saucepan 3/4 of water with lots of salt and put 3 foil balls to help me float the bowl. As soon as it boiled I’ll take the temperature down to a simmer and add in the chocolate chips and 1tsp of coconut oil. As soon as I see the chocolate start to melt I start stirring, making sure I scrap the bottom and keep it moving. The key is slow rise in temperature to prevent scorched chocolate. I like the glass bowl because I can keep an eye on the bottom to make sure I am scrapping throughly.

Most likely the chocolate you are using doesn’t have a high enough fat content for that long of a cooking time. If you are using chocolate chips or bars, add in a tap of coconut oil or butter.
